title: Qualitative Insights Tool (QualIT): LLM Enhanced Topic Modeling
task: Topic and sub-topic discovery for qualitative research (talent management)
problem: LDA misses nuanced semantics and BERTopic assumes one topic per document.
architecture: Claude-2.1 extracts key phrases per document; a hallucination check removes phrases whose embedding cosine similarity to the document (Amazon Titan embeddings) is below 10%; two-level K-Means clustering of key phrases gives topics and sub-topics.
key_results: At 20 topics: coherence 70.0% and diversity 95.5% vs BERTopic 65.0% / 85.0% and LDA 57.0% / 72.0%.
Averaged over 10-50 topics: coherence 64.4% vs BERTopic 61.0%; at 40-50 topics BERTopic is slightly better on coherence.
At least 2 of 4 evaluators agreed on 80% of QualIT topics vs 45% for BERTopic.
strengths: Handles multiple topics per document via key phrases and filters hallucinated phrases.

limitations.text: Runtime of 2-3 hours vs about 30 minutes for BERTopic; K-Means less effective than HDBSCAN in preliminary comparisons.
Single benchmark dataset and only two baselines; proprietary LLM.
